title: SAFETY OFFICERS
industry: Construction, Building and Architecture, Occupational Health and Safety
description:
SAFETY OFFICERS
Global Constructions Ltd
has a reputable history of over 30 years in the Civil Construction industry in Papua New Guinea.
We are currently seeking to recruit:
SAFETY OFFICERS
for various  Project site locations in Alotau, Magi highway- Central province and POM.
Requirements:
Preferably a resident of respective locations
Relevant tertiary qualification in safety.
At least 5 years’ experience in OH&S at operational level in a large-scale organisation, preferably multi-site.
Professional communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence at management level.
Demonstrated knowledge of safety statutory requirements, regulations, codes of practice and guidelines, and the ability to translate and apply these to a work environment.
Energy, enthusiasm and passion to work as part of a team.
Good Analytical Skills with an eye for detail.
Duties:
Provide site safety leadership
Conduct daily pre start H & S Tool box meetings on site
Carry out inspections for the purpose of regulating and ensuring safety policies are aligned with company regulations and the national standard and legislative requirements focusing on safety.
Incident/Accident reporting
Responding to and investigating complaints on safety matters and take appropriate action
prepare site safety reports for management, EOM safety Audit
Provide expert safety and wellbeing advice and technical support to line management.
Identification of issues impacting safety and wellbeing at sites.
Compiling Safe Work Method statements, Standard Operating Procedures and various other reporting.
Managing Workers’ Compensation claims and injury management processes.
Operational tasks including incident investigations, risk assessments and delivering health and safety training programs.
Maintaining, updating and managing emergency response plans and evacuation procedures.
